neighbours.label: The verb closing a reduced object relative clause after a 'first/main/biggest X' noun phrase ('the main challenge young doctors face'), and 'by the time they ...'
fire: The main challenge young doctors face is the long night shifts.
The first obstacle most beginners encounter is learning the scales.
The biggest hurdle small farmers face is the price of seed.
The first thing visitors notice is the smell of fresh bread.
One problem new parents face is the lack of sleep.
The first question every patient asks is how long it will take.
Children have usually lost their baby teeth by the time they turn twelve.
The toughest test new recruits face is the mountain march.
quiet: Young doctors often complain about the long night shifts.
Most beginners struggle at first with learning the scales.
Small farmers worry a great deal about the price of seed.
Visitors to the shop love the smell of fresh bread.
New parents often complain about the lack of sleep.
Every patient wants to know how long it will take.
Children usually lose their baby teeth around the age of twelve.
New recruits dread the long march over the mountain.

notes: Probe: 'the first problem new students face' 0.89, 'a guest enters is' 0.50, 'by the time they' 0.45, 'risk investors take' 0.32; but 'The first problem for new students is' leaked 0.31, so near misses drop the 'The first X ... is' frame as well and state the content with a plain main verb.
